name: classified-marketplace
description: Moderated classified listings marketplace — React + Node/Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
